contradiction.prose_clause: The sequential_selection.site0 sentence says candidate MLP0 is scored with deployed MLP1/2.
contradiction.causal_context_clause: The causal_objective.site0 context requires projected-oracle MLP1 so a correct downstream MLP1/suffix reads the site-0 error.

resolution.rule: The explicit R0 equation and matching causal-context clause jointly control; 'deployed MLP1/2' is interpreted as deployed MLP2 only for site-0 validation.
resolution.reason: This is the unique reading consistent with both the explicit arm algebra and the registered causal fit context. It is frozen before any site-0 labels, logits, gradients, or validation outcomes are consumed.

shuffle_control_selection_clarification.rule: Fit and validate the identical A-E family/rank/lambda grids. Among B-E candidates satisfying the same copy constraint, apply the same 1%-near-best, price, family, size, and lambda tie-break. Positive recovery remains a claim-admission requirement for the real compiler only, not an existence requirement for the literal shuffle null.
shuffle_control_selection_clarification.nonpositive_case: When the best signed shuffle recovery is nonpositive, retain exact recovery maximizers before deterministic price tie-breaking, because multiplicative 0.99 slack reverses order for negative values.
shuffle_control_selection_clarification.reason: Otherwise a successful null with all recovery <=0 aborts before the preregistered final QQN-versus-shuffle comparison can exist.

full_native_tolerance_interpretation.physical_identity: Use the pinned preflight-r2 convention 4e-6*max(1,max absolute reference physical correction) for serialized full-native versus live O physical correction.
full_native_tolerance_interpretation.gauge_distinction: The separate absolute physical-drift <=2e-6 clause governs signed-output-gauge replay of an already serialized program; it is not the full-native float32 serialization identity tolerance. Applying it to full-native serialization would contradict the pre-outcome pinned preflight-r2 gate, whose observed valid float32 physical drift was approximately 4.9e-4.

scope: Interpretation only. No threshold, family, row, objective, real-winner admission rule, or final gate changes.
